title: Stronger Than Bare Hands
description:
Armor is your allowance for mistakes. Even ordinary pieces are worthwhile when your next cave contains creatures you have never seen.

This trial detects one of three vanilla chestplates; different modded armors will be added after exact registry verification. It does NOT verify a full armor set.

Field note: Begin with any armor that fits your playstyle. Rare items are not necessary for the first expedition.

objectives.name: Equip a practical piece of armor
